🎥🎬: Dracula: A Love Tale (2025)

Prince Vlad of Wallachia is deeply in love with his wife, Elisabeta, but tragedy strikes when she is killed after he leaves to fight the Ottoman forces. Devastated and furious with God for allowing her death, Vlad renounces his faith and is cursed with eternal life, transforming into the vampire Dracula. 

For the next 400 years, Dracula wanders the world searching for Elisabeta’s reincarnation. His search finally leads him to 19th-century Paris, where he discovers that Mina, the fiancée of solicitor Jonathan Harker, is the woman he has been waiting centuries to find.

Dracula reunites with Mina and tries to rekindle the love he once shared with Elisabeta, while a determined priest hunts him down and seeks to end his curse. Ultimately, Dracula realizes that truly loving Mina means refusing to condemn her to his immortal existence. He sacrifices himself, allowing the curse to end and giving Mina her mortal life back.
